annotations.title: Taxpayers by income bracket by postcode

description:
How many taxpayers in each postcode fall into each of five taxable-income brackets, per income year 2016-17 to 2023-24.

Coverage: About 2,530 postcodes; income years 2016-17 to 2023-24. Current to 2024-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/income-distribution`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: bracket_1, bracket_2, bracket_3, bracket_4, bracket_5. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
